notes:
- **"I haven't watched it yet" on Home.** If something turns up in "Rate what
  you watched" that you didn't actually watch, one click removes it from the
  list and stops it counting as watched.
- **Mark a whole season watched at once.** On a series, each season now has a
  "Mark season watched" button that ticks off every episode in that season —
  and flips to "Unmark season" once the whole season is watched.
